title: Repair regional latency boxplot (wrong median claim, tiny text, unlabelled y-axis)
what: True ap-northeast median latency (ms), ratio to us-east, or difference vs us-east (ms)

reader_questions.question: What is the true median latency in ap-northeast?
reader_questions.expected: About 141 ms (roughly 3.0× us-east's 48 ms), not 312 ms.

reader_questions.question: Is ap-northeast's latency distribution cleanly above us-east?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; the IQR boxes for ap-northeast and us-east are completely separated across 60 requests each.

reader_questions.question: How do the four regions rank from fastest to slowest median latency?
reader_questions.expected: us-east (48 ms) < us-west (64 ms) < eu-central (91 ms) < ap-northeast (141 ms).
